subject: Kickoff: MAP & Eval Plan for BrightHealth AI — scheduling and attendee confirmation
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brighthealth.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Torres <mtorres@brighthealth.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: alignment + scheduling

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the quantization options you showed. Wed like to get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and evaluation plan stood up so we can align on success criteria and a close target (we're aiming for an internal procurement sign-off by mid-December).

Proposed objective for the kickoff: introductions, roles, confirmation of evaluation artifacts (test prompts, dataset access), and a high-level schedule for the POC. Our attendees will likely be: Alyssa Chen (data lead), Michael Torres (engineering), Emily Park (security) and our procurement lead (TBD).

Constraints: we need SOC2 evidence and a short description of data retention before final procurement review. Also, availability-wise, were tight the week of 11/29.

Can you propose 2–3 45-minute slots next week for a kickoff? If you have a draft MAP or agenda you can share ahead that would help the stakeholders prepare.

Thanks,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen
Data Science Lead, BrightHealth AI
alyssa@brighthealth.ai

I've attached a very small draft MAP (MAP-draft-BrightHealthAI-v1.xlsx) and a tentative agenda (Agenda-draft-20261123.pdf). The agenda covers: intros & roles (10m), success criteria & eval artifacts (15m), POC timeline & milestones (10m), open questions & next steps (10m).

Zoom link and calendar hold below (I'll send a formal invite once we confirm):
https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=MAPkickoff

I've looped in Sean (customer success) to outline the eval deliverables and Monica to coordinate any environment onboarding. Vivek is copied for any Dedicated/private deployment considerations.

- Share any redlines/contract must-haves ahead of time
- If you have an internal success rubric, please paste it into the reply

Best,
